g.text: Local tables show full columns. Orange boxes are cross-domain references defined in another slice.

g.title:
PK: id
Unique: uq_users_email(email)
Check: ck_users_role: role IN ('ui_superadmin', 'ui_admin', 'ui_user', 'ui_none')
Indexes: ix_users_id(id) [index]
PK: id\nUnique: uq_user_ui_group(user_id, group_id)\nIndexes: ix_user_ui_groups_group_user(group_id, user_id) [index]; ix_user_ui_groups_id(id) [index]

PK: id\nIndexes: ix_api_tokens_created_at(created_at) [index]; ix_api_tokens_id(id) [index]; ix_api_tokens_jti(jti) [unique]; ix_api_tokens_token_hash(token_hash) [unique]; ix_api_tokens_user_id(user_id) [index]

PK: id\nIndexes: ix_refresh_tokens_auth_session_id(auth_session_id) [index]; ix_refresh_tokens_expires_at(expires_at) [index]; ix_refresh_tokens_family_id(family_id) [index]; ix_refresh_tokens_revoked_at(revoked_at) [index]; ix_refresh_tokens_token_hash(token_hash) [unique]

PK: id\nUnique: uq_external_identity_subject(provider_type, provider_id, subject)\nIndexes: ix_external_identities_email(email) [index]; ix_external_identities_revoked_at(revoked_at) [index]; ix_external_identities_user_id(user_id) [index]

PK: id\nUnique: unnamed(challenge_hash)\nIndexes: ix_auth_challenges_binding_sid(binding_sid) [index]; ix_auth_challenges_expires_at(expires_at) [index]; ix_auth_challenges_purpose(purpose) [index]; ix_auth_challenges_user_id(user_id) [index]
